claims.assertion: Swaruu describes collective timelines as shared perception agreements; when they fracture, people may experience many variants of several outcomes.
claims.speaker: Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She describes roughly four broad lines, with individual variants.

claims.assertion: She says mass meditation and shared focus alter the unified field from which collective reality manifests; thoughts shape it more than physical actions.
claims.speaker: Swaruu

claims.assertion: Swaruu presents direct positive nonhuman military intervention as a possible outcome, imposing a holographic society by force and causing deaths.
claims.speaker: Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: A scenario, not a stated prediction; she says intervention depends on imminent mass violence.
